Add the spirit, modifiers and citrus in the order listed.
Top with the carbonated ingredient, where applicable.
Stir gently two or three times and garnish.
substitutions: Canadian whisky: rye-forward Canadian whisky is preferred; bourbon may be used but will taste sweeter.
Sweet vermouth: use a fresh, refrigerated bottle. A drier vermouth may require a small increase in sweetener.
